entries.name: Image and document converter
entries.description: Converts images and structured documents entirely in the browser. Files are not uploaded.
entries.privacy: Processing stays on the device. There is no account and no server-side file storage.

entries.name: Date converter
entries.description: Synchronizes Solar Hijri, Gregorian, and Lunar Hijri dates in the browser.
entries.privacy: Date calculations stay on the device and are not sent to a server.
